end_effector.name: wxai_v0_base
end_effector.finger_offset_meaning: offset_finger_left/right are the palm-centre to carriage-centre offsets with the fingers at the closed configuration, in metres. They are not the gripper joint coordinate.

configuration.arm_control: position mode; set_arm_positions to IK joint targets, blocking
configuration.measured_point: side of a finger at the centre of the fingertip end (beside the tool point along tool y, which is horizontal)
configuration.pitch_meaning: tool x axis angle below horizontal, pointing away from the base

units.measured_mm: mm, fingertip centre above the table, ruler
units.efforts: driver arm efforts, compensation efforts and external efforts (Nm)
